title: KOZYFLY Washable Area Rug 5x7 ft Rubber Backed Non Slip Rugs for Living Room Braided Cotton Bedroom Rug Woven Office Rugs Indoor Floor Carpets for Dining Bedroom Living Room, Tan/Orange/Brown
features: Check Door Clearance: The 5' x 7' (60" x 84") rug is 0.2" thick, with reinforced edges up to 0.35". If your door gap is under 0.4", this rug may prevent it from opening smoothly. Measure your door clearance before purchase

Tan/Orange/Brown: This rug blends light beige, light brown, and deep brown for a neutral look that complements various decor styles. Note: color may visually appear lighter, more yellow, darker, or browner under different lighting conditions

Rug Setup Tips: This boho indoor outdoor doormat has a rubber non-slip backing to reduce slipping. The thickened edges are slightly higher than the rug surface—press down firmly and use a smaller non-slip pad to prevent tripping and add stability

Remove Rug Creases: Our folded packaging optimizes transport and storage. To smooth out creases, gently iron over a damp towel, reverse roll the rug, or lay it flat with heavy objects. The boho braided rugs will regain its shape in a few days

Machine Washable: Vacuum or shake to keep this washable rug fresh. Machine wash on a delicate cycle and air dry to extend its life; no dryer and bleach. Note: Cotton rugs may shrink and wrinkle after washing; if needed, iron on low heat to restore shape.
